name: Finland – tehomaksu (Energiavirasto 2026)
assumed: The grammar is national and set by Energiavirasto's määräys, in force 2026-02-02: the tehomaksu applies to the part of the 60-minute average power that exceeds an eight-kilowatt threshold, taken over the month, which is `Linear(free_kw = 8)` on the month's highest hour (HLD §8's FI row). The 8 kW is the regulator's (an earlier draft circulated at 5 kW; 8 came into force). The unit price is NOT the regulator's — every DSO sets its own — so 2.50 EUR/kW/month here is a representative figure and the one D2 §9 8 uses. A site should replace it with the €/kW/month from its own DSO's price list; the shape, the threshold and therefore the steering are right either way. Under the same määräys a DSO must also offer households with a main fuse of at most 3 × 63 A a product *without* a tehomaksu, and the criteria must be in use by 2029-01-01: a household on that product should pick `custom` instead.
